newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy 98 net debt forecast to fall 26.5 trln lire.
newsitem.headline: Italy 98 net debt forecast to fall 26.5 trln lire.

text.p: Italy's 1998 net indebtedness is forecast the fall by 26.5 trillion lire, according to an official statement released on Friday on the government's three-year economic targets for 1998-2000.
The statement said the reduction included 1.5 trillion lire saved as a result of lower interest repayments.

Treasury Minister Carlo Azeglio Ciampi earlier said the forecast interest bill for 1998 was 175 trillion lire, down from 202 trillion in lire in 1996 and from 183.3 trillion in the previous official forecast for 1998. Italy's debt is around 2,000 trillion lire, most of it internal.
